C1597.title: Remote Control via Mobile Trojan Using Kali and Metasploit
C1597.summary: Demonstrates generating an APK backdoor on Kali using msfvenom to create a reverse TCP connection trojan. After installation on an Android device, a C2 channel is established via the Metasploit console to obtain a shell, enabling remote control including camera access, audio recording, and file browsing.

references.title: How to Use Mobile Trojans for Remote Control
